tech.title: IT technical school, internships and events
tech.description:
I graduated from Zespół Szkół Technicznych nr 3 in Płock with an IT technician qualification.
 I also completed professional internships, working as a computer repair technician and teaching IT classes to students at a local technical high school.
 In 2019 and 2022, I took part in Hackathon Płock, gaining experience in developing projects as part of a team and using Git for version control. I also attended talks by IT industry professionals.

courses.title: Programming courses
courses.description: I developed my web development skills through courses by Samuraj Programowania and later joined the third edition of MegaK. The course lasted over a year and provided daily learning materials and assignments. It focused mainly on frontend and backend development with JavaScript and TypeScript and concluded with a team project.

work.title: IT support
work.description: I develop and maintain a website and, until recently, also built and managed an online store powered by WordPress. I manage software on company computers and provide ongoing IT support.

uni.title: Full-time undergraduate studies at Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń
uni.description:
With assessment largely based on projects, my studies have given me broad practical experience and taught me to adapt quickly to new technologies.
During my studies, I have attended numerous talks by experts in IT and the sciences.
I take part in meetings of the computer science student society, through which I have undertaken several academic projects.
